attendance_policy: Regular attendance and active participation in class will be monitored and recorded. Absenting from classes without prior permission, lack of punctuality in reporting to class, non-submission of evaluative reports/assignments as per the scheduled timeline, can all impact Grades during evaluation.
makeup_policy: Make-up may be granted only to genuine cases (hospitalization), subject to getting permission from IC. No make-up for Quiz/Assignments/Mini-projects under any circumstance.
